📺 Raven’s Home (2017–2023)

Raven’s Home follows Raven Baxter, a fun-loving single mother who possesses the extraordinary ability to see glimpses of the future. Years after her teenage adventures, Raven is now raising her twins, Booker and Nia, while sharing a home with her longtime best friend Chelsea and Chelsea’s son Levi. Life becomes even more chaotic when Booker discovers that he has inherited his mother’s psychic abilities, leading to hilarious misunderstandings, unexpected adventures, and complicated situations as they both attempt to change the future. As the family navigates school, friendships, parenting challenges, relationships, and everyday struggles, Raven learns that raising children can be just as unpredictable as her visions. Starring Raven-Symoné, Anneliese van der Pol, Issac Ryan Brown, Navia Robinson, and Jason Maybaum, the series delivers hilarious comedy, heartwarming family moments, and meaningful lessons about friendship, responsibility, growing up, and the importance of family.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Fantasy • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 7.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-G

🎥 Creators: Jed Elinoff & Scott Thomas

📺 Seasons: 6 • 122 Episodes

📚 Spin-Off Of: That’s So Raven (2003–2007)

🏆 Awards: Received multiple Daytime Emmy Award and NAACP Image Award nominations.

📺 Where to Watch: Disney+ (United States)

source_details.synopsis: Raven's Home is an American family sitcom television series developed by Jed Elinoff and Scott Thomas that aired on Disney Channel from July 21, 2017 to September 3, 2023. The series stars Raven-Symoné, Issac Ryan Brown, Navia Robinson, Jason Maybaum, Sky Katz, and Anneliese van der Pol for its first four seasons. Raven-Symoné and Issac Ryan Brown returned for the fifth season, alongside Mykal-Michelle Harris, Felix Avitia, Emmy Liu-Wang and Rondell Sheridan. Based on the characters created by Michael Poryes and Susan Sherman, the series is a spinoff of That's So Raven, the second spinoff from that series after Cory in the House.
